expansion_only_comparator.scope: A deliberately weak comparator, not a recommended rule.

primary.name: reproducible_correlated_residual_gate
primary.scope: A matrix-level coherence screen, not an affinity-accuracy, target-retrieval, pose-validity, receptor-quality, or box-validity criterion.
primary.threshold_provenance: Fixed before inspecting simulation outcomes: rho>=0.70 requires substantial seed reproducibility; a null ratio<=0.80 requires at least a 20% PR deficit; and p<=0.05 requires lower-tail separation from the row-norm null.
